definition: RAISE US is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization created to address the disruption to American workers caused by artificial intelligence.
details: It has received over $500 million from major corporations including OpenAI, Amazon, Anthropic, and Bank of America. It is co-chaired by former Indiana governor Eric Holcomb and Gina Raimondo, the former governor of Rhode Island and United States Secretary of Commerce, who also is CEO.

explainer.lead: RAISE US is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit created to address the disruption to American workers caused by artificial intelligence. It matters because it channels major corporate funding toward worker disruption from AI.

tiers.eli5: It is a charity set up to help workers whose jobs are affected by AI, funded by big companies.
tiers.practitioner: Organizations track it as an example of industry-funded efforts to address AI's labor impact. A pitfall is assuming corporate funding implies independence from funders' interests.
tiers.paperLevel: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit with over $500 million received from corporations including OpenAI, Amazon, Anthropic and Bank of America; co-chaired by Eric Holcomb and Gina Raimondo, who is also CEO. No formal evaluation criteria are specified.
